subject: help on testing LC_ALL in LyX under Mac OS

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: help on testing LC_ALL in LyX under Mac OS
parts:
Hi,

Can someone in the list using both Mac and LyX test one thing for me?
I'm wondering what this code chunk gives you in LyX and plain R
respectively:

<<>>=
sessionInfo()
x = as.list(Sys.getenv())
str(x[grep("^L[AC]", names(x))])
@

I'm trying to solve this issue but do not have access to the
environment: https://github.com/yihui/knitr/issues/464

I suspect LyX sets LC_ALL before loading R, which might be
inappropriate (may be should just unset/remove it). I also suspect it
caused the trouble for R.App to set the correct locale (should be
en_US.UTF-8 instead of C in that case), but this does not happen under
Ubuntu (I got en_US.UTF-8 as expected in sessionInfo()).

Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
